# core

**In one sentence:** the frontend's foundation: startup, the typed handle to the Python bridge, tiny DOM helpers, error display, and base CSS.

## Why it exists
Everything else in `static/` needs the same few things: a way to call Python, a way to find elements, a safe boot sequence, and a visible error when something breaks (a pywebview window has no console unless started with `--debug`).

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `api.js` | `api()` returns `window.pywebview.api`, the Python `UiBridge`. Most of the file is JSDoc `@typedef`s describing every bridge method and payload (project, job, each review modal, settings). |
| `app.js` | `init()` — reads `app_info`, loads projects, binds shell/library/settings events, then opens the library or (for `--mock`) jumps straight into the project shell. |
| `boot.js` | `bootOnPywebviewReady(start)` — runs `start` once the pywebview API exists, whether it was injected before or after the script loaded. |
| `errors.js` | `installErrorSurface()` shows a red banner for uncaught errors; `runBoot(fn)` surfaces a failed boot; `cleanError(err)` keeps the last line of a Python exception for form messages. |
| `dom.js` | `$` (getElementById), `setText`, `setShellStatus` (sets `#app[data-job-status]`), `stepLabel` (`CaptionBboxStep` → `Caption Bbox`), `escapeText` (HTML-escape). |
| `state.js` | One-line re-export of `state` from `../+state/index.js`. |
| `foundation.css` | Base resets, element defaults, scrollbars, and helpers (`.primary`, `.secondary`, `.danger`). Its header comment holds the overflow/scrolling rule. |

## How it works
- `static/app.js` installs the error surface, then calls `bootOnPywebviewReady(() => runBoot(init))`.
- `init` decides between the library view and the shell view.
- Every bridge call goes through `api().<method>()`, which returns a Promise.

## Who uses it
- `api.js`, `dom.js`: almost every module in `job/`, `library/`, `project/`, `settings/`, `shell/`, `components/`, `steps/`.
- `errors.js`: `static/app.js`, `library/modal.js`, `settings/settings.js`.
- `foundation.css`: imported by `static/styles.css` after the design tokens.
- Tests: `tests/ui/static/boot.test.js`; `css_overflow.test.js` enforces the overflow rule.

## Good to know
- Keep `api.js` JSDoc in sync with `prepare_lora_kit_ui/bridge.py` and the runner payloads.
- `state.js` is only imported by tests (`tests/ui/static/*.test.js`, `interaction_helpers.js`); app code imports `+state/index.js` directly.
- `foundation.css` must load after `styles/tokens.css`, which defines the `var(--...)` values it uses.
- The error banner in `errors.js` sets `overflow:auto` inline; the overflow test only checks `.css` files.
